arms.comparison_boundary: Only relay ACP-0008 integration differs; source and destination integration are disabled for every arm.

experiment.control_interpretation: Compare the observed per-arm relay integrated/direct emission counts for DEFAULT versus CALIBRATED and DISABLED; record a distinction only when values differ. No difference is required, and no historical count is a target.

execution.second_run: full deterministic replay from fresh per-sequence state

floating_point_policy.decimal_hex: decimal and float.hex() must decode to bitwise-identical binary64
floating_point_policy.derived_input: recompute float(x) + float(y) independently per arm and replay

numerical_checks.edge_arrival: transfer.timestamp ~= emission.timestamp + 1.0 under formula; transfer.timestamp > emission.timestamp exactly
exact_criteria: raw identities, route event IDs/endpoints/path/lineage, batching, event order, and replay digests
strict-future edge arrival and exact captured dt
numerical_checks.relay_classification: integrated_discharge iff independent recurrence admits an ordinary episode with nonzero integrated discharge
numerical_checks.relay_discharge: when integrated, abs(z_input)>=theta_z, and x_input*z_input>=0, discharge sign(z_input)*theta_z; compare post-discharge x/z
numerical_checks.relay_dt: trace.elapsed equals captured event timestamp minus captured prior relay neuron clock exactly
numerical_checks.relay_input: x_input=clip(x_decay+input); integrate z only when mode_before=N and abs(x_input)<theta_e
tolerance_criteria: Model-B payload and one-unit route arrival timestamps

verdict_rules.blocked: Provenance, capacity, replay, or causal/publication blocker.
verdict_rules.not_supported: Valid fixture and execution contract, but no calibrated integrated relay mechanism in this new baseline.
verdict_rules.supported: Valid provenance, causal routing, resource bounds, and replay; calibrated integrated relay emissions reconcile to ordinary onward transfer.
